<p>Record which of the standard steps a calculation performs
</p>

## Usage

```r
make_action_cli(x)
```

## Arguments

<dl class="qrtdown-arguments">
<dt id="arg-x"><code>x</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-x"></a></dt>
<dd><p>Character vector of the steps the function performs.</p></dd>
</dl>

## Value

<p>A named logical vector with one element per standard step:
aggregate, shift, compare, proportion of total and count distinct.
</p>
